memory: Established: the phase glitch is edge‑triggered and tied to the demod update. Holding the update strobe delays the event. Gating the FPGA fabric clock delays but does not suppress the ~0.50 ms, ~0.19° excursion; prior suppression was an averaging artefact. New: stopping both fabric and PLL outputs across an update does not suppress the excursion — it reliably occurs after clock restart, time‑locked to resumption. Current position: the event executes on clock resumption, suggesting a stored internal transition or analog charge release. Next objective: capture internal analog/digital nodes noninvasively across halt/resume.
openQuestion: Which internal analog/digital node (charge pump, integrator, latch) transitions on clock restart, and can I capture it nondestructively?
